name: Hubei Dinglong CO.,Ltd.
summary: Hubei Dinglong CO.,Ltd. engages in research, development, production, and service of circuit design, semiconductor materials, printing and copying general consumables. It offers integrated circuit materials, including polishing pads, polishing fluids, and cleaning fluids. The company provides semiconductor display materials, comprising OLED, LCD, and micro-LED, as well as general consumable and copying products. The company was formerly known as Hubei Dinglong Chemical Co., Ltd and changed its name to Hubei Dinglong CO.,Ltd. in September 2016. Hubei Dinglong CO.,Ltd. was founded in 2000 and is based in Wuhan, China.
